title: Alma redemptoris mater (Gaspar, Motet cycle Quam pulchra es)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Motet cycle Quam pulchra es, Alma redemptoris mater. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0302b), edited by Christina Cassia (MCE 6: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Quam pulchra es, 2021); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. Edition published by Gaffurius Codices Online, Motet Cycles Edition (https://www.gaffurius-codices.ch/s/portal/page/editions). Copyright 2021, Pavanello, Agnese. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
